'''Rankin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] holding the rank of the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was assigned to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Galactic War]] in [[3642 BBY]], where he greeted Imperial personnel on the Imperial orbital station before directing them to the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]].
